steps: Register to vote in York County, PA and meet poll worker qualifications (registered voter, 17+ with permission for students, not a government official/employee, not on the ballot).
Contact the York County Elections and Voter Registration office to be appointed as a Clerk (clerks are appointed by the Judge of Elections).
Attend the required training session (in-person or online) before the election ($25 attendance compensation).
Report to the assigned polling place by 6:00 AM on Election Day and assist in setup for 7:00 AM opening.
Serve the full Election Day until dismissed by the Judge of Elections after polls close and closing procedures are complete.
Sign the Election Officers' Oath and the white pay sheet with current mailing address; receive the $150 day rate + $25 training check by mail.
timing: Election Day: 6:00 AM until dismissed by the Judge of Elections after polls close (half-day afternoon shift is 1:30-9:00 'or close', so full day is 15+ hours).
